title: Django is pinned to a legacy major
incompatibilityReason: Older Django majors can leave the project carrying outdated middleware, settings, and deployment assumptions into a Python runtime upgrade.
defaultTechnicalRecommendation: Upgrade Django to a currently supported major before or during the Python runtime rollout.

title: Flask is pinned to a legacy major
incompatibilityReason: Older Flask majors can lag behind current Werkzeug and Python runtime expectations, increasing upgrade friction.
defaultTechnicalRecommendation: Upgrade Flask and its serving stack to a currently supported major before finalizing the Python runtime cutover.

title: FastAPI is pinned below the current compatibility baseline
incompatibilityReason: Older FastAPI releases are more likely to be tied to pre-Pydantic-v2 assumptions that complicate Python runtime and framework upgrades.
defaultTechnicalRecommendation: Upgrade FastAPI to a modern release line and validate the ASGI stack on the target Python runtime.
